readerCopy.summary: The officials responsible for continuity face the people demanding a complete break from the existing system.
readerCopy.body: The officials responsible for continuity face the people demanding a complete break from the existing system. One side points to safety, law, records, and services that cannot simply stop; the other points to exclusion, failure, and a structure that uses stability to protect itself. Saturn holds the duty to maintain order, while Uranus gives the demand for reform enough force to make delay untenable. The opposition places institutional responsibility across from public refusal without allowing either side to claim there is no risk. The replacement may be necessary, but the final plan reveals whose stability was protected and whose disruption was treated as acceptable.
